unit_cn: Unit 2 Language and Culture 语言与文化
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 2 Glossary 真词(跳过 △ 超纲词);IPA 标准词典英音回填,英美差异给 ipa_us;例句原创、语言与文化主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: I signalled to the seller that I could not wait any longer.
words.example_cn: 我向卖家示意我不能再等了。

words.example_en: She pointed at her wrist to show that she was in a hurry.
words.example_cn: 她指了指手腕,表示自己赶时间。

words.example_en: He was obviously confused by the foreign gesture.
words.example_cn: 他显然被这个外国手势弄糊涂了。

words.example_en: The misunderstanding really wasn't my fault.
words.example_cn: 这个误会真的不是我的错。

words.example_en: The strange experience slowly faded from my memory.
words.example_cn: 那段奇怪的经历慢慢从我记忆中淡去。

words.example_en: Understanding the word took not fluency in the language, but fluency in the culture.
words.example_cn: 理解这个词靠的不是语言的流利,而是文化的熟稔。

words.example_en: This word should almost never be taken literally.
words.example_cn: 这个词几乎从不能按字面意思理解。

words.example_en: The meaning of the word changes greatly with the context.
words.example_cn: 这个词的意思随语境变化很大。

words.example_en: "Ahorita" could mean within five years or even never.
words.example_cn: "Ahorita"可能指五年之内,甚至永远不。

words.example_en: Since I moved abroad, my attitude towards time has changed.
words.example_cn: 自从我搬到国外,我对时间的态度就变了。

words.example_en: My idea of being on time has changed dramatically.
words.example_cn: 我对守时的看法发生了显著的变化。

words.example_en: I am generally still on time for my appointments.
words.example_cn: 我赴约通常还是很准时的。

words.example_en: When I am a little late now, I don't panic.
words.example_cn: 现在我稍微迟到时,也不会惊慌。

words.example_en: I couldn't imagine what "French fries" were.
words.example_cn: 我想象不出"French fries"是什么。

words.example_en: Was it something fried, like snails or cheese?
words.example_cn: 那是炸出来的东西吗,比如蜗牛或奶酪?

words.example_en: She was amazed that I had never tried French fries.
words.example_cn: 她很惊讶我从没吃过炸薯条。

words.example_en: The waiter brought us a plate of chips.
words.example_cn: 服务员给我们端来一盘薯条。

words.example_en: In England, gravy is a salty, meat-based sauce.
words.example_cn: 在英国,gravy 是一种咸的、以肉为主的调味汁。

words.example_en: In America, "biscuits" can mean savoury snacks.
words.example_cn: 在美国,"biscuits"可能指咸味小吃。

words.example_en: I felt embarrassed when a stranger said she liked my "pants".
words.example_cn: 一个陌生人说喜欢我的"pants"时,我感到很尴尬。

words.example_en: There are likely to be many differences in the same language.
words.example_cn: 同一种语言里很可能存在许多差异。

words.example_en: The two kinds of English differ not just in vocabulary but also in spelling.
words.example_cn: 这两种英语不仅在词汇上不同,在拼写上也不同。

words.example_en: A confusing word often points to a difference in culture.
words.example_cn: 一个令人困惑的词常常指向文化上的差异。

words.example_en: The same language may be spoken in different ways in different countries.
words.example_cn: 同一种语言在不同国家可能有不同的说法。

words.example_en: His face showed a mix of confusion and surprise.
words.example_cn: 他脸上混合着困惑与惊讶。

words.example_en: "Ahorita" is a confusing word for many foreigners in Mexico.
words.example_cn: 对许多在墨西哥的外国人来说,"ahorita"是个令人困惑的词。

words.example_en: It is even used as a polite way of saying "no, thanks".
words.example_cn: 它甚至被用作礼貌地说"不,谢谢"的方式。

words.example_en: I felt it was impolite to walk away without a word.
words.example_cn: 我觉得一句话不说就走开很不礼貌。

words.example_en: The word can be directly translated as "right now".
words.example_cn: 这个词可以直接翻译成"现在"。

words.example_en: The literal translation of the phrase is "I am your slave".
words.example_cn: 这个短语的字面译文是"我是你的奴隶"。

words.example_en: The same gesture may carry different meanings in different cultures.
words.example_cn: 同样的手势在不同文化中可能含义不同。

words.example_en: People in some countries use their hands to express feelings.
words.example_cn: 在一些国家,人们用手来表达感受。

words.example_en: Different gestures are used to show disagreement.
words.example_cn: 人们用不同的手势来表示不同意。

words.example_en: The two kinds of English also differ in pronunciation.
words.example_cn: 这两种英语在发音上也有差异。

words.example_en: British and American English use different spelling for some words.
words.example_cn: 英式和美式英语对某些词用不同的拼写。

words.example_en: A stranger told me she liked my "pants".
words.example_cn: 一个陌生人告诉我她喜欢我的"pants"。

words.example_en: The word often confuses a foreigner who speaks fluent Spanish.
words.example_cn: 这个词常常让说一口流利西班牙语的外国人困惑。

words.example_en: My friend asked me if I wanted to order French fries.
words.example_cn: 我朋友问我想不想点炸薯条。

words.example_en: I saw an "eggplant" pizza on the menu and felt confused.
words.example_cn: 我在菜单上看到"eggplant"披萨,感到很困惑。

words.example_en: I couldn't imagine what an "eggplant" could be.
words.example_cn: 我想象不出"eggplant"会是什么。

words.example_en: I later discovered that understanding the word took a fluency in the culture.
words.example_cn: 我后来发现,理解这个词需要的是对文化的熟悉。

words.example_en: I later realised that "biscuits" in America are savoury snacks.
words.example_cn: 我后来意识到,美国的"biscuits"是咸味小吃。

words.example_en: Cultural differences in languages caused the confusion.
words.example_cn: 语言中的文化差异造成了这种困惑。

words.example_en: "Ahorita Time" is a reflection of different understandings of time.
words.example_cn: "Ahorita Time"反映了人们对时间的不同理解。

words.example_en: There are many varieties of English throughout the world.
words.example_cn: 世界各地有许多种英语变体。

words.example_en: The word can be a polite way to refuse an offer.
words.example_cn: 这个词可以是礼貌地拒绝邀约的方式。
